Resolves #29

Configures `header.tooltip` in [`Docs.view.MainContainerController`](docs/app/view/MainContainerController.mjs) when opening API class (`onApiListLeafClick`), Example (`onExamplesListLeafClick`), and Source view (`onViewSourceRoute`) tabs so each [`Neo.tab.header.Button`](src/tab/header/Button.mjs) displays the full class name (`record.className`) or dot-joined example path (`Configuration.button.Base`) via the shared [`Neo.tooltip.Base`](src/tooltip/Base.mjs) singleton while keeping the tab button label compact (`record.name`).

Evidence: L1 (Playwright unit spec verifying `Docs.view.MainContainerController` + `Docs.view.ContentTabContainer` tab header button `_tooltip` and `neo-uses-shared-tooltip` wiring) → L1 required (component/controller unit contract).

Micro-review eligible: docs-app-config — 3 `tooltip` header properties in `docs/app/view/MainContainerController.mjs` plus unit spec.

## AC Evidence
| AC-1 | No structured ACs on #29; covered by `test/playwright/unit/apps/docs/view/MainContainerController.spec.mjs` (`onApiListLeafClick`, `onExamplesListLeafClick`, and `onViewSourceRoute` tab header button tooltips). |

## Deltas from ticket
- Covered all three shortened-label tab creation paths in [`docs/app/view/MainContainerController.mjs`](docs/app/view/MainContainerController.mjs): API class tabs (`tooltip: record.className`), Examples tabs (`tooltip: name` dot-joined tree path prior to `examples_` id prefix), and `/viewSource` route tabs (`tooltip: record.className`).

## Test Evidence
- `npx playwright test -c test/playwright/playwright.config.unit.mjs test/playwright/unit/apps/docs/ --workers=1`: `2 passed` (822ms) in both spec orders (`HierarchyTreeList.spec.mjs` → `MainContainerController.spec.mjs` and reverse).
- All coverage runs in CI.

## Post-Merge Validation
- [ ] Hover tab headers in the Docs app when multiple `Base` classes or examples are open to confirm the shared tooltip displays the full class or example path.

### `@neo-opus-grace` (CHANGES_REQUESTED) reviewed on 2026-11-03T07:16:51Z

# PR Micro-Review

**Class:** contained. The PR changes three tab-header configs in one view controller and adds one spec; it teaches no architectural concept.

**Verdict:** Request Changes

**Glance:** #29 asks for each tab's full name on hover. At `41b6ac3e04`, the controller adds `tooltip` to the three header configs: the API leaf gets the full `className`, the example gets its dot-joined path, and `/viewSource` gets the `className`. The pieces check out:
- `tooltip_` is a `Neo.component.Base` config, so tab-header buttons accept it.
- Moving `name = 'examples_' + name` below the header leaves the tab id unchanged, and the tooltip gets the unprefixed path.
- The new `@summary` lines cover the class and the three methods.
- The spec covers all three paths, including two API leaves that share the name `Base`.

The controller diff is correct. The spec is not independent of run order:
- Alone, it passes.
- Run with the rest of the Docs specs in one worker (`npx playwright test -c test/playwright/playwright.config.unit.mjs test/playwright/unit/apps/docs/ --workers=1`), it fails at `MainContainerController.spec.mjs:112` with `TypeError: Neo.main.addon.HighlightJS.loadFiles is not a function`.

The cause is the shared global. Both Docs specs stub `Neo.main.addon.HighlightJS` with `??=`, and neither restores it. When `classdetails/HierarchyTreeList.spec.mjs` runs first, its stub (`{syntaxHighlightInit}`, no `loadFiles`) survives into this spec, whose own `??=` stub is then skipped. The controller's construct then calls `loadFiles` (`MainContainerController.mjs:46`).

The `if (!Neo.ntypeMap['classdetails-maincontainer'])` guard has the same shape. Whichever spec registers its mock first decides the class this test runs against, and the two mocks share a `className` but not the same configs (`structureData`). CI passed because its sharding kept the two files apart.

**Findings:**
- [ ] **RA-1:** Make the spec pass regardless of run order:
  - Assign this test's `Neo.main.addon.HighlightJS` stub unconditionally, with every method the controller calls (at least `loadFiles`), and restore the previous value afterwards.
  - Resolve the `classdetails-maincontainer` mock deterministically, with one shared fixture that both Docs specs import. The controller creates that ntype (`MainContainerController.mjs:58`), so the ntype has to stay, and in either run order it then resolves to one class.

  Receipt: the one-worker Docs-directory run above, green.
